ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read password-standard.txt, then bring the relay account into compliance: `net user relay <new password>` that actually meets every requirement.
files.C:\\Citadel\\password-standard.txt:
CITADEL PASSWORD STANDARD
----------------------------
Every account password must:
1. Be at least 12 characters
2. Mix upper case, lower case, a number, and a symbol
3. Never contain the account name
4. Avoid common words attackers guess first (password, admin, 12345, qwerty, citadel)

The relay account currently fails this standard: password is "starlight" (8 characters, no number, no symbol).
